text.price: $2,097 psf, the median resale price over the last 24 months (Oct 2024 to Sep 2026).
text.comparison: Resale prices are about 8% above similar developments in District 20.
text.record: Prices rose 21% between 2021–23 and 2024–26 (adjusted for unit size), against about 16% for developments with similar features in District 20 — more than similar developments.
infrastructure: Upper Thomson MRT, about 190 m (straight line to the nearest exit).
Ai Tong School, about 400 m: 1.9 applicants per place in Phase 2C, 2025. Admission depends on the exact address.
supply: 1 development within 2 km is still selling, with about 12 unsold homes (URA developers' sales, Sep 2026).
Thomson Reserve (1,268 homes, about 100 m) launched after URA's latest monthly figures; its sales are shown from URA's next release.
text.demand: 44 resales in the last 24 months, in 22 of 24 months.
text.answer: Right by an MRT station and a popular primary school within 1 km. Resale prices are about 8% above similar developments in District 20.
